text: A model on its own is like a clever person in a locked room, only able to pass notes under the door.
Tools are the model's hands: they allow Claude to read spreadsheets, search the web, run calculations, and create documents.
The harness is the software wrapped around the model—the complete workshop.
It provides the tools, runs the working loop, and enforces the rules about what Claude may do.
The Claude app is one harness; Claude Code is another.
In short: the model thinks, tools let it act, and the harness provides the tools and rules.
You decide what Claude is allowed to do.
